pages.text: Not the plague but its cousin, and it comes in any phase: $(l)Sweating Sickness$() takes those who overheat (by Cold Sweat's reckoning, if it is about, or else those who run about hot country in the heat of the day).$(br2)Drenching sweat, hunger, weakness, and fast. But a $(2)full night's sleep$() breaks it, and Herbal Broth or Theriac cure it.
